description: After refinement, REQ-RETRY raises the attempt bound from three to five.

proposal.rationale: Gateway SRE asked for more retry headroom during brown-outs.

patch.body: Retry only transient gateway errors up to five attempts, using bounded exponential backoff and a stable idempotency key.

acceptance_criteria: At most five attempts are made
Backoff increases between retries with a configured upper limit
Every attempt uses the original idempotency key
